channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Lawn Fertilizer Calculator - Pounds Per Feeding and Bags a Year
item.description: Lawn size, the bag label rate and the holiday rhythm give pounds per feeding, bags a year and the cost - with the soil-test note that saves a feeding. Free.

item.title: Air Purifier Size Calculator - The CADR Number That Matters
item.description: Room size and your reason for buying give the CADR to look for on the seal - allergies double it, smoke more - plus the marketing number to ignore. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Gutter Cleaning Cost Calculator - Per Visit, Year and Guards Payoff
item.description: Gutter feet, stories and debris load price each cleaning and the year - and answer the guards question with a real payoff math. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Wedding Budget Calculator - Total, Per Guest and the Guest-Count Lever
item.description: Guests, catering, bar and flat costs give the real total with a 10 percent buffer - and the guest-count math that saves more than any vendor negotiation. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tax Refund Planner - The 70/30 Split That Saves Real Interest
item.description: Your refund split between the highest-APR card, the emergency fund and a guilt-free fun share - with the interest saved and the phishing warning. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Spring Break Budget Calculator - Per Person Cost, All In
item.description: Flights, shared lodging, days and the daily food-and-fun line give the per-person cost, the group total and the daily burn. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Super Bowl Squares Calculator - Pool, Payouts and the Split
item.description: Square price times 100 gives the pool, and the payout split by quarter shows exactly what each winner collects - with the house-cut rule. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Raised Bed Soil Calculator - Cubic Feet, Bags and Cost
item.description: Bed dimensions times depth give cubic feet of soil, the 1.5 cu ft bag count, the cost, and the two-inch top-up figure for established beds. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Seed Starting Calculator - When to Sow Indoors Before Last Frost
item.description: Last frost date plus your crop gives the indoor sowing date, the transplant week, and days from today - tomatoes to lettuce on the consensus table. Free.

item.title: Date Night Cost Calculator - Dinner, Activity and the Sitter Truth
item.description: Dinner, activity and sitter hours give the real per-date cost, the monthly figure and the year - with the swap-circle fix that halves it. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Charitable Miles Calculator - Volunteer Driving Deduction at 14 Cents
item.description: Volunteer miles at the statutory 14 cents plus parking and tolls - with the 501(c)(3) rule, the commute exclusion and the log that survives audit. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Self-Employment Tax Calculator - Your 1099 Set-Aside Percentage
item.description: Expected 1099 income plus your bracket gives the set-aside percentage, the SE tax, quarterly payments and the safe-harbor rule that ends penalty fear. Free.

item.title: Home Office Deduction Calculator - Simplified vs Actual Method
item.description: Square feet times 5 dollars under the simplified method, compared against your actual expense share - with the exclusive-use gate that decides everything. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Heating Oil Tank Calculator - Days Left, Refill Cost and Order Timing
item.description: Tank size, gauge reading and burn rate give usable gallons, days of heat left and the refill cost - with the order-at-one-third rule. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Meal Prep Batch Calculator - Cost Per Meal vs Takeout
item.description: Batch portions and ingredient cost versus your real takeout price - savings per week, batches to cook, and the year figure. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Credit Card Minimum Payment Calculator - Years and Interest Revealed
item.description: Balance and APR versus the minimum-payment math: years to repay, total interest, and what a fixed payment saves - the trap made visible. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: PTO Optimizer - Turn Vacation Days into Maximum Days Off
item.description: Split your PTO across chained breaks so weekends ride free - see calendar days off versus one naive block, plus the Wednesday trick. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Slow Cooker Converter - Oven Time to Low and High Settings
item.description: Convert any oven recipe time to slow cooker hours on low or high - with the liquid, dairy and lid-lid rules that carry the dish. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Home Gym Payback Calculator - Months to Beat the Membership
item.description: Equipment cost over your gym fee gives the payback months, the quit-case net with resale, and the 300-dollar starter kit reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Ice Melt Calculator - Bags of Salt for Your Driveway This Winter
item.description: Driveway area, product type and storm count give pounds per application, bags for the winter and the cost - with the pet-paw and concrete warnings. Free, no sign-up.
